Getting Started¶

Use one of the following options to install and run RACS:

  • Install with Docker
  • Build from source

Hardware Compatability¶

RACS supports both x86_64 and arm64 architectures. For arm64, the host byte order must be little-endian.

OS Compatability¶

RACS is compatible with Linux Kernel 4.19+ and macOS 10.15+.
